A8 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
A loop call is a model's decision about a local enrichment, not an observation. Six
pooled files means six thresholds, and a pair linked in one and not another is
counted as linked here.
Loop calls come from the same population-averaged experiment as the matrix. A loop
is a frequency across millions of nuclei, not a contact in any one of them.
A7 compares two loop lists that differ in depth, caller and assembly at once, so it
attributes a difference to resolution that is only mostly about resolution.
Everything here is still bounded by what the candidate sets contain: the screens
chose which elements to test against which genes.
